create_schematic_plotter: create a SchematicPlotter instance with a visdom visualization backend for plotting voxel schematics
draw_plotly_scatter: use SchematicPlotter drawPlotly to render a 3D scatter plot of voxel data in visdom
draw_matplot_3d: use SchematicPlotter drawMatplot to render a 3D matplotlib figure of voxel blocks with Minecraft colors
draw_color_hash_visdom: call draw_color_hash to visualize a hash-binned voxel schematic as a colored 3D scatter in visdom
plot_cube_at_position: call plotCubeAt to draw a single colored cube at a given 3D position on a matplotlib axis
